integrity: All theorem steps are presented analytically; finite seeded checks are supplemental. No external or independent review is implied.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is limited to exactly 2x2 real iid standard Gaussian matrices and ordinary partial pivoting in exact arithmetic; it provides no statement about high-dimensional growth, non-Gaussian entries or rounding error. Full-text priority verification of some specialist literature, including Urschel (2026), is incomplete.
title: The sharp Gaussian edge law for two-by-two partial-pivoting growth
